title: MaxKernel: Agentic Kernel Generation for TPUs
abstract: arXiv:2609.04523v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Designing and authoring high-performance custom kernels for accelerators is a complex task that requires deep hardware-level expertise. Large Language Models (LLM) can be leveraged together with real-time compiler feedback to build agentic systems for kernel generation. In this work, we present MaxKernel, a multi-agent system that implements three distinct paradigms for TPU kernel development: (1) a Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) agent for collaborative, step-by-step design; (2) an Autonomous (Auto) agent that executes a fully automated, metric/trace-driven optimization loop; and (3) a Graph-Based Autonomous Search that scales the Auto agent for global exploration of the design space. All three paradigms leverage a shared pool of specialized sub-agents to handle planning, implementation, self-debugging, testing, and hardware profiling. translated_title: MaxKernel：面向TPU的智能体化内核生成
translated_abstract: 设计和编写面向加速器的高性能定制内核是一项复杂的任务，需要深入的硬件级专业知识。大型语言模型（LLM）可以与实时编译器反馈相结合，构建用于内核生成的智能体系统。在本工作中，我们提出了MaxKernel，这是一个多智能体系统，为TPU内核开发实现了三种不同的范式：(1) 人在回路（HITL）智能体，用于协作式、逐步的设计；(2) 自主智能体，执行完全自动化的、由指标/追踪驱动的优化循环；(3) 基于图结构的自主搜索，将自主智能体扩展到设计空间的全局探索。这三种范式都利用一个共享的专门化子智能体池来处理规划、实现、自调试、测试和硬件性能分析。我们在JaxBench上评估了MaxKernel，这是一个包含50个多样化TPU内核任务的综合基准套件，同时还对（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: MaxKernel提出了一个面向TPU内核开发的多智能体系统，通过人在回路、自主指标/追踪驱动优化和基于图的自主搜索三种范式，并结合共享的专业化子智能体池（负责规划、实现、自调试、测试和性能分析），实现高性能TPU内核的自动化生成。
en_tdlr: MaxKernel is a multi-agent system for TPU kernel development that offers three paradigms—human-in-the-loop design, fully autonomous metric/trace-driven optimization, and graph-based autonomous search—leveraging a shared pool of specialized sub-agents to automate the generation of high-performance TPU kernels.
